additional_info.subject: Trend from Parent ticket - TS to RC
additional_info.body:
After our chat just now, we can clearly see that the temperature sensor readings are not okay. We can see ~2.7kOhm in the 2nd temperature sensor (violet-white, if i'm not mistaken)
As you explained, it seems that the cable is jumping the values, sometimes it's working and sometimes no.
Here are the next troubleshooting steps:
Measure the temperature sensor and check if there is 1kOhm (remember to remove the cables from the connectors in order to avoid a bad reading).
If yes, then measure on the StateMonitor.
If it has 1kOhm, try replacing the grey connector.
If it still doesn't work, even though we have 1kOhm at the input, please replace the StateMonitor.
If it doesn't have 1kOhm, then we need to check backwards, where we lose the 1kOhm, maybe in the XD12, measure before and after this connector.
If no, then the cable sensor is faulty and needs to be replaced the whole CCS
Another thing we can check is if there was any water leakage, can you please shake the plug and see if you can feel water inside? I had a similar issue in a different country where the symptoms are the same, so it could be this too.

additional_info.subject: Trend from Parent ticket - RC to TS
additional_info.body:
The measurements on the PT1000 sensors are fine. Both directly on the cable and at the KF13.
We get 1106 ohm.. So that looks ok, around 27 degrees. The plug has been in the sun.
Got the same reading on the KF13 plug.
We tried to replace the KF13, it did not change anything, it was the same error.
What we noticed was that the error came when the plug was connected to the car.
Could it be a loose connection to the sensor in the plug?
